newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia to begin talks on admission to WTO - paper.
newsitem.headline: Croatia to begin talks on admission to WTO - paper.

text.p: Croatia will begin a first round of negotiations with member countries of the World Trade Organisation (WTO) later this month to prepare steps for its admission, local daily Vjesnik reported on Wednesday.

Croatian officials will meet representatives of the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, the European Union, Switzerland and some central European countries in Geneva on May 15 and 16, the paper said.
Bilateral talks, the first with the WTO after a year's pause, will focus on customs concessions for imported goods and services, it added.
No government officials were immediately available to comment.

A Croatian delegation last visited the organisation's headquarters in Geneva to discuss membership in April last year. Its admission to the WTO is one of the conditions to gaining access to the Central European Free Trade Organisation (CEFTA). -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
